contexts.name: Analytical Entity
contexts.sovereign_question: Which owned domain concept plays an entity role in an analytical model?
invariants: Every analytical entity imports exactly one domain concept owner.
Entity role does not create a new business identity.

contexts.name: Analytical Grain
contexts.sovereign_question: What exactly does one fact or observation occurrence represent?
invariants: A fact occurrence has one declared grain.
Grain changes are semantic compatibility changes.

contexts.name: Fact and Measure
contexts.sovereign_question: What phenomenon is observed or recorded and what value, unit and aggregation posture represents it?
invariants: Every measure has a semantic value type.
Quantity-valued measures declare unit and dimension.
Aggregation posture is explicit.

contexts.name: Dimension and Hierarchy
contexts.sovereign_question: Along which governed attributes, members and levels may analytical observations be sliced or grouped?
invariants: Every hierarchy level has one meaning and owner.
Rollup paths declare strict, ragged, balanced and temporal posture.

contexts.name: Relationship and Valid Join Path
contexts.sovereign_question: Which semantic relationships permit which analytical joins without unintended fanout or loss?
invariants: Every path declares cardinality and grain effect.
Ambiguous equally valid paths are not silently selected.

contexts.name: Pure Formula Expression Algebra
contexts.sovereign_question: What does a typed formula expression mean independent of registries, providers, I/O and enterprise vocabulary?
invariants: Type checking precedes evaluation.
Absence and error propagation are explicit.
No ambient time, I/O or randomness exists in the pure algebra.

contexts.name: Formula Definition Registry
contexts.sovereign_question: Which named formula definition and edition exists, who owns it and what is its lifecycle status?
invariants: Identity and edition are separate.
Published definitions are immutable.
Recall preserves historical interpretation.

contexts.name: Formula Semantic Binding
contexts.sovereign_question: To which owned measures, metrics, dimensions, parameters and time semantics does each formula reference bind?
invariants: Every free reference binds exactly once.
Binding preserves type, unit, grain and time constraints.

contexts.name: Formula Evaluation
contexts.sovereign_question: How is a bound formula evaluated under explicit data cuts, budgets, determinism and evidence obligations?
invariants: Evaluation pins expression, binding, provider and input cuts.
Budget exhaustion is distinct from semantic refusal.

contexts.name: Metric Definition
contexts.sovereign_question: What measure over what population, grain, filters, aggregation, dimensions and time does a metric mean?
invariants: All metric coordinates are explicit.
Metric compatibility is semantic, not name-based.
Semi-additive behavior is declared by dimension and time.

contexts.name: Metric Authority and Policy
contexts.sovereign_question: Which metric edition is authoritative for which purpose, population and interval, and who may change or recall it?
invariants: Approval is not publication.
Overlapping authoritative editions require explicit precedence.

contexts.name: Analytical Semantic Model
contexts.sovereign_question: Which analytical entities, facts, measures, dimensions, relationships, metrics and valid queries compose one provider-neutral model?
invariants: References resolve to one positive edition.
No duplicate semantic owner is introduced by composition.

contexts.name: Semantic Model Publication
contexts.sovereign_question: Which validated semantic-model edition is published to which consumers with what compatibility and support posture?
invariants: Publication pins one validated model edition.
Consumer obligations survive deprecation until disposition.

contexts.name: Semantic Query
contexts.sovereign_question: What governed analytical result is requested in semantic terms over which dimensions, filters, time and exact model edition?
invariants: Every selected metric and dimension exists in the pinned model edition.
Ambiguous time and join semantics are refused.

contexts.name: Semantic Query Lowering
contexts.sovereign_question: Can a validated semantic query be lowered to available logical-query capabilities without changing its meaning?
invariants: Successful lowering retains a source map and preservation evidence.
Unsupported semantics cannot be approximated silently.

contexts.name: Metric Observation
contexts.sovereign_question: What metric result was observed for which governed definition, model edition, exact data cut, query and execution evidence?
invariants: Every observation pins all semantic and data editions.
An observation remains an observation until an owning business context admits it.
